newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot natgas prices rise on plant outage.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot natgas prices rise on plant outage.

text.p: Spot natural gas prices in western Canada were inflated Monday by a scheduled outage at a British Columbia gas plant, traders said.

Westcoast Energy's Fort Nelson gas plant, with a capacity of about 750 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd), was limiting their flows to about 400-500 mmcfd for some planned maintenance, market sources said.
As a result, prices at Sumas, Wash., rose by more than 10 cents to about $1.30 per million British thermal units (mmBtu) in light trade.
